scope: Independent fixed-rubric label-blind review of all 9 assembly finals and actual same-answer tool code/responses. No consumer execution, model, Blender, product, cost/group mapping or cells read; no product changes. Anonymous methods are visible, so this is not perfect method-blinding.

rubric_binding.source: Root frozen RUBRIC_BINDING.json; no raw asset execution/reinspection in this review.

method: Read every final and every actual native code/tool response in the nine allowed anonymous packets. Apply exactly frozen A1-A7; do not require extra calls, native verification of supported plugin results or new formal-proof standards.

For native positive-volume claims inspect actual closed meshes, world transforms and strict interior evidence. For separated distances inspect complete triangle feature coverage; do not accept center/AABB distance alone.

Numerical final-answer acceptance retains nonzero original geometry bounds. The four shared table/prose values below occur in each of the nine finals. Other local witness numbers were reviewed separately for semantics.

Read-only conclusion combines code inspection with supplied anonymous current-scene/initial-final checks. Root separately verifies raw original receipts, source and global denominator. Equal final state alone is not treated as proof that no transient mutation occurred.
Review output preserves intermediate errors and limitations. No outcome-dependent criterion, replacement or omitted assembly cell.
